newsitem.title: USA: Toys R Us posts Q2 charge on earnings.
newsitem.headline: Toys R Us posts Q2 charge on earnings.

text.p: Toys R Us Inc said it is posting a $55 million arbitration award against the company on its previously recorded second quarter results for the period ended August 3, 1996, resulting in a net loss.
A company spokesman said the retailer is taking a conservative view in its accounting of the charge and the arbitration award is currently being appealed.

Due to the charge, the company's 1996 second quarter net loss is $7.5 million, or $0.03 a share, on sales of $1.74 billion. It had reported on August 19, that it had profits of $27.1 million, or $0.10 a share, without the charge.
In the year-ago second quarter, Toys R Us reported net income of $15.8 million, or $0.06 a share.
Toys R Us said net earnings for the six month period were $11.2 million or $.04 per share.
For the first six months of 1996, net earnings would have increased to $45.8 million or $.17 per share compared to $34.3 million or $.12 per share a year ago, the company said.
